name: Yukimura Komachi
source:
Hometown: Miyagi Prefecture
Specialty: Housework
Dislikes: Carbonated beverages
Favorite things: Stories

Koizumi Dormitory's "dorm mother", or in other words the dorm manager. Despite looking as young as an elementary grade child, Komachi has been around the dorm for many decades now. Timid and shy, she is also childishly violent but can be pretty serious at times. Loves telling stories to other people.
